{{Quote|Rescue workers have been working around the clock to reach some 4,000 passengers and workers who were trapped in a monorail traveling through the Pica Rim Pipeline after a series of bombs ruptured a 4,000 kilometer section of the undersea transit tube.|A news report by Colonial News Nets|<ref name="GNN" />}}
'''Albrae-Don''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="GNN" /> located in the [[Albrae-Don system/Legends|Albrae-Don system]], a part of the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its surface featured a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. The [[Pica Rim Pipeline]], an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] [[Train/Legends|train]] [[Transit tube|transit tunnel]] more than 4,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length, was located on Albrae-Don, as was the [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Draeo-Kax]].<ref name="GNN" />

After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death/Legends|execution]] of [[Earnst Kamiel]], the founder and leader of the [[Justice Action Network]],<ref name="GNN" /> on the date [[1 ABY/Legends|36:10:4]],<ref name="GNN Kamiel">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|183|Justice Action Network (2)}}</ref> carried out a [[Attack on the Pica Rim Pipeline|retaliatory strike]] on Albrae-Don. JAN detonated a series of bombs at the Pica Rim Pipeline, rupturing and flooding a section of the tunnel. As a result, a monorail with approximately 4,000 passengers and workers aboard was trapped and surrounded with [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of water, requiring intensive efforts by rescue workers to free the passengers. In [[2 ABY/Legends|37:6:20]], [[Colonial News Nets]] issued a news report from Draeo-Kax detailing the rescue efforts on Albrae-Don.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Albrae-Don was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]], which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and published in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Albrae-Don [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Albrae-Don itself, within grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
